source: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 Artificial intelligence: Management system. Clause and Annex A area references with our own summaries; the standard's text is copyrighted and not reproduced. Buy the standard from ISO or your national body.
disclaimer: This repository is general information to help you understand and organize work on AI governance frameworks. It is not legal advice and does not guarantee compliance, certification or any regulatory outcome. Requirements are summarized in our own words; always check the official texts and get qualified advice for your situation.

requirements.title: Context of the organization
requirements.summary: Understand internal and external issues, interested parties; define the AI management system scope and your AI roles.
requirements.evidence: Context and interested-party register; scope statement; AI role statement.

requirements.title: Leadership
requirements.summary: Top management commitment, an AI policy, and assigned roles and responsibilities.
requirements.evidence: Approved AI policy; RACI; management communications.

requirements.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
requirements.summary: Plan AI risk assessment, AI risk treatment (with a Statement of Applicability against Annex A) and AI system impact assessment.
requirements.evidence: Risk criteria; risk assessment; Statement of Applicability; impact assessments.

requirements.title: AI objectives
requirements.summary: Set measurable AI objectives and plans to achieve them.

requirements.title: Planning of changes
requirements.summary: Plan changes to the management system in a controlled way.

requirements.title: Support
requirements.summary: Resources, competence, awareness, communication and documented information.
requirements.evidence: Competence records; awareness training; document control.

requirements.title: Operation
requirements.summary: Operate planned processes; perform AI risk assessments, risk treatment and impact assessments at planned intervals and on change.
requirements.evidence: Operational records; updated assessments; treatment status.

requirements.title: Performance evaluation
requirements.summary: Monitoring and measurement, internal audit and management review.
requirements.evidence: Metrics; audit program and reports; review minutes.

requirements.title: Improvement
requirements.summary: Continual improvement, nonconformity and corrective action.

requirements.title: Policies related to AI (Annex A area)
requirements.summary: Controls on documenting and reviewing AI policy and its alignment with other policies.

requirements.title: Internal organization (Annex A area)
requirements.summary: Controls on roles, responsibilities and reporting of concerns.

requirements.title: Resources for AI systems (Annex A area)
requirements.summary: Controls on documenting data, tooling, system, computing and human resources.

requirements.title: Assessing impacts of AI systems (Annex A area)
requirements.summary: Controls on impact assessment process and documentation for individuals, groups and society.

requirements.title: AI system life cycle (Annex A area)
requirements.summary: Controls on objectives for responsible development, design, verification, deployment, operation, monitoring and technical documentation.
requirements.evidence: Life cycle procedures; verification and validation records; technical documentation.

requirements.title: Data for AI systems (Annex A area)
requirements.summary: Controls on data acquisition, quality, provenance and preparation.
requirements.evidence: Data sheets; data quality and provenance records.

requirements.title: Information for interested parties (Annex A area)
requirements.summary: Controls on system documentation for users, external reporting and incident communication.

requirements.title: Use of AI systems (Annex A area)
requirements.summary: Controls on processes and objectives for responsible use and intended use.

requirements.title: Third-party and customer relationships (Annex A area)
requirements.summary: Controls on allocating responsibilities and managing suppliers and customers.
